future_preflight_sequence: Read and authenticate explicit stageL3 grant binding exact reviewed implementation/assignment SHA, expiry, test paths and budget; absence/mismatch rejects before numerical import.
Check clean isolated worktree, accepted ancestry, exact locked source/config/panel and fixture/oracle hashes; fail closed on mismatch; verify source paths not original Efficiency cwd.

Inspect process inventory, active scientific workers and owner MEASURED_ACTIVE/D3_ACTIVE guards across relevant result roots; preserve owner/mtime and refuse conflicting work, never delete or rename their guard.

Check >=2GiB free initially, available memory/headroom and new empty output directory; no output root under archives/source or another worker. Record disk/memory values, not inferred old observations.

Resolve supported actual numerical backend controls in a fresh worker. For this Mac use reviewed configure_accelerate(1) with VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 before numerical imports; record returned status/mode. For other backends require separately qualified supported controls, not generic env assumptions.

Only then import numerical packages and record their binary/version/module origins, BLAS/LAPACK/backend receipt, threadpool info, process thread samples and CPU/wall observations. Environment values alone are not evidence of execution behavior. Unknown historical IPOPT plugin identity remains unknown; no optimizer plugin construction is needed or permitted.
Run only the exact reviewed tests under same supervised allocation before candidate analysis; any prerequisite failure preserves logs and stops affected stage without favorable retry.
Reserve counters before each original grid slot; <=12candidate IDs and <=960 suffix slots before dedup. Model/AD/FD calls use allocation tokens, no prewarming or uncounted scans.
supervision: One worker process group, sequential; supervisor polls monotonic time/RSS/disk/output/thread observations every0.1s; no concurrent tests/analysis/rendering/benchmark.

At elapsed295s no new work; flush and finalize inside300s. <=1s grace must fit remaining allocation, then TERM/KILL as needed and reap process group. Poll/OS scheduling may prevent a certified hard wall bound; report actual elapsed and overrun rather than claim exact enforcement.

At observed RSS>=1GiB terminate/censor and report peak-observed plus monitor gap. macOS sampled monitoring is not a hard memory cap; L3 review must accept this limitation or qualify real enforcement before hard-bound claims.
At output>=95% of1GiB stop new work; include all logs, temps, test artifacts and exports inside same reservation; below1GiB free stop/censor. Never delete prior results to gain budget.
Signal handlers/append-only JSONL flush only within resource bounds; final index labels torn tail bytes and missing ranges. No old artifact overwrites or retry to replace unfavorable evidence.

output_schema.exact_encoding: UTF-8 strict JSON or one complete object per JSONL line; finite float64/scalar values only; no NaN/Infinity tokens. complex={re:number,im:number}; infinity is null+condition_kind. Matrices retain shapes, names, units, normalization, source and validity.
semantic_guards: Validate row/column names and all nested array dimensions against explicit shapes.
Source binding set SHA and exact operating tuple/map/chart/authority semantics must match referenced records.
All12candidate IDs remain in coverage even if invalid/unavailable/unexecuted; match immutable panel order and exact identity hashes.
Count requested suffix slots BEFORE deduplication, enforce960; all persisted gain/sample indices inside original packet/gain interval.

Products may only use completed contiguous factors in declared authority/design scope. At truncation a prefix norm is labeled COMPLETED_PREFIX_ONLY and requested endpoint metric remains unavailable; missing ranges explicit.

Failed comparisons may retain computed payload and reasons; unexecuted/unavailable/invalid records have data=null and reasons plus immutable context. Raw offending values recorded in structured reason fields, not fabricated result arrays.
Strict no-NaN and duplicate-key rejection before schema. Unexpected extra fields rejected by closed schemas.
No actual result records emitted at L0; no fixture/toy oracle relabeled as a candidate result.

Qualification record.status describes whether the qualification procedure ran. If computed procedure returns qualification INVALID/UNAVAILABLE, qualification_data may retain archived tuples, evaluated checks and null missing values. Matrix/result records with status INVALID/UNAVAILABLE still have data=null; no matrix is backfilled. Coverage uses the qualification result, not the procedure-executed status.
